what: Visual review of every Tables I–VIII cell where the page-image reading (tools/verify_test_matrix_images.py) disagreed with data/extracted/test_matrix.csv.
reviewer: Claude (AI assistant) in Phase B M3, by viewing the crop montage; not an independent human reviewer.
limits: Confirms the CSV reproduces what Tables I–VIII print; says nothing about whether the printed values are correct.
